sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The country of Myanmar is accused of a state-sponsored campaign of massacre, rape and arson against the Rohingya Muslims who live there.
sentences.zh: 缅甸被指控对居住在那里的罗兴亚穆斯林实施了国家支持的屠杀、强奸和纵火运动。

sentences.en: So why did the government of Myanmar allow a Times reporter to tour the epicenter of the alleged atrocities?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么缅甸政府会允许《纽约时报》的记者参观这些所谓暴行的中心地带呢？

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: We are following breaking news this morning.
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注今天早上的突发新闻。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government declaring the ongoing violence against the Rohingya Muslims in Myanmar as ethnic cleansing.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布缅甸针对罗兴亚穆斯林的持续暴力行为属于种族清洗。

sentences.en: The people are frightened, hungry and stateless.
sentences.zh: 这些人感到恐惧、饥饿且无国籍。

sentences.en: The stateless Muslim minority are the casualties of fresh clashes between Rohingya militants and Myanmar's security forces.
sentences.zh: 这些无国籍的穆斯林少数群体是罗兴亚武装分子与缅甸安全部队之间新一轮冲突的受害者。

sentences.en: The Human Rights Watch condemned the latest evidence and says it proves a systematic slaughter of Rohingyas.
sentences.zh: 人权观察组织谴责了最新的证据，并称这证明了对罗兴亚人的系统性屠杀。

sentences.en: I had been covering for many years the persecution of the Rohingya, who are a minority Muslim people in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我一直在报道罗兴亚人的受迫害情况，他们是缅甸的少数穆斯林群体。

sentences.en: Myanmar is majority BuddhiSt.
sentences.zh: 缅甸是一个以佛教徒为主的国家。

sentences.en: And last August, there were attacks by Rohingya Muslim insurgents on some police posts and an army station in northern Rakhine, which is where the Rohingya are concentrated.
sentences.zh: 去年8月，罗兴亚穆斯林叛乱分子袭击了若开邦北部的一些警察哨所和军队驻地，那里是罗兴亚人的聚居区。

sentences.en: And there was a very brutal, very mysteriously quick reaction to those insurgent attacks in which village burnings, executions, rapes, you know,
sentences.zh: 随后，针对这些叛乱袭击，出现了一种非常残酷、非常迅速且令人费解的反应，包括焚烧村庄、处决、强奸，你知道的，

sentences.en: all the horrible things that constitute ethnic cleansing happened.
sentences.zh: 所有构成种族清洗的可怕事情都发生了。

sentences.en: And within a very short period of time, around 700,000 Rohingya fled from Myanmar to neighboring Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 在很短的时间内，大约70万罗兴亚人从缅甸逃往邻国孟加拉国。

sentences.en: And so I wanted to see the epicenter, kind of the ground zero of ethnic cleansing.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要去看看那个中心地带，也就是种族清洗的“归零地”。

sentences.en: Hannah Beach is the Southeast Asia Bureau Chief for The Times.
sentences.zh: 汉娜·比奇是《纽约时报》东南亚分社社长。

sentences.en: I had spent months and months applying to get to northern Rakhine.
sentences.zh: 我花了几个月的时间申请进入若开邦北部。

sentences.en: It's an area in which foreign journalists in particular have been basically not allowed to go.
sentences.zh: 那是一个外国记者基本上被禁止进入的区域。

sentences.en: We could talk in refugee camps in Bangladesh to people who had very consistent, compelling stories.
sentences.zh: 我们在孟加拉国的难民营里可以采访到那些讲述着非常一致且令人信服的故事的人们。

sentences.en: But you want to see the place.
sentences.zh: 但你还是想亲眼看看那个地方。

sentences.en: You know, you want to see the charred villages.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你想看看那些烧焦的村庄。

sentences.en: You want to see the carcasses of the mosques.
sentences.zh: 你想看看清真寺的残骸。

sentences.en: You want to be there.
sentences.zh: 你想身临其境。

sentences.en: And Myanmar is a really difficult place to report.
sentences.zh: 而且缅甸是一个非常难进行报道的地方。

sentences.en: Even before you get there, you have to apply for a journalist visa.
sentences.zh: 在你到达之前，你必须申请记者签证。

sentences.en: That can take weeks.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要几周时间。

sentences.en: It can take months.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能需要几个月。

sentences.en: And in July, I got a letter from the Burmese authorities.
sentences.zh: 七月份，我收到了缅甸当局的一封信。

sentences.en: And they said, congratulations, you have permission to go to northern Rakhine.
sentences.zh: 他们说，恭喜你，你获得了前往若开邦北部的许可。

sentences.en: Hannah, knowing what happened here, knowing that this is the epicenter of this military action,
sentences.zh: 汉娜，了解那里发生的事情，知道那是军事行动的中心地带，

sentences.en: I find it sort of shocking that the Myanmar government would allow journalists like you to the scene of what is essentially their own crime.
sentences.zh: 我觉得缅甸政府竟然允许像你这样的记者进入他们本质上是自己犯罪的现场，这令人震惊。

sentences.en: Why would they do that?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: I think largely because from the Myanmar government and military perspective, this is not the site of ethnic cleansing.
sentences.zh: 我认为很大程度上是因为从缅甸政府和军方的角度来看，这里并不是种族清洗的现场。

sentences.en: What we heard over and over again, as hard as it is to maybe believe, is that the Rakhine and the military do not burn down the houses.
sentences.zh: 我们反复听到——尽管可能很难相信——若开人（当地族群）和军方并没有烧毁房屋。

sentences.en: They do not execute people.
sentences.zh: 他们没有处决任何人。

sentences.en: They do not rape women.
sentences.zh: 他们没有强奸妇女。

sentences.en: We heard that the Rohingya themselves burned down their own villages.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的是罗兴亚人自己烧毁了自己的村庄。

sentences.en: Burned down their own villages.
sentences.zh: 烧毁了自己的村庄。

sentences.en: That's the government's explanation.
sentences.zh: 这就是政府的解释。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's what we heard from dozens of people, not only from the military and officials, but also from some adult Rakhine villagers.
sentences.zh: 我们从几十个人那里听到的都是这样，不仅是军方和官员，还有一些成年的若开村民。

sentences.en: And, you know, it sounds kind of crazy, but this is the consistent narrative that you hear.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这听起来有点疯狂，但这确实是你所听到的统一口径。

sentences.en: So in their minds, they're taking you on a tour of a place where this thing that you have been told has happened actually hasn't happened the way you've been told it did.
sentences.zh: 所以在他们看来，他们带你参观的地方，正是为了证明你被告知发生的事情并没有按你所听到的那样发生。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they want to correct our understanding of what happened.
sentences.zh: 他们想纠正我们对所发生之事的理解。

sentences.en: So how does this tour start?
sentences.zh: 那么这次参观是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: I was there with a group of foreign journalists.
sentences.zh: 我和一群外国记者一起去了那里。

sentences.en: And each kind of journalistic group, publication or TV network is given its own car.
sentences.zh: 每一个新闻团体、出版物或电视网络都会被分配一辆车。

sentences.en: We have our own driver.
sentences.zh: 我们有自己的司机。

sentences.en: We had a pretty nice soldier who had a gun that was very close to our shoulders.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一名相当友好的士兵，他的枪离我们的肩膀非常近。

sentences.en: So you have a minder.
sentences.zh: 所以你有一个监护人。

sentences.en: You have a minder there.
sentences.zh: 你在那里有一个监护人。

sentences.en: We have a minder, an armed minder, who is in the back of our car.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个监护人，一个武装监护人，坐在我们的车后座。

sentences.en: And every time we would stop, particularly the photographer, Adam Dean, really wanted to capture images and take pictures of the burned out mosques and things.
sentences.zh: 每次我们停车时，特别是摄影师亚当·迪恩，他真的很想捕捉画面，拍摄那些被烧毁的清真寺之类的东西。

sentences.en: And at one point, our friendly armed police guy saw Adam sort of running down the street.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们那位友好的武装警察看到亚当在街上跑来跑去。

sentences.en: And he commented to Sao Nang, my Burmese journalist colleague.
sentences.zh: 他对我那名缅甸记者同事Sao Nang评论道。

sentences.en: He said, you know, is your photographer over there?
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，那是你们的摄影师吗？

sentences.en: I think if he doesn't have a bulletproof head, it would be advisable for him to come back.
sentences.zh: 我想如果他的头不是防弹的，最好还是让他回来。

sentences.en: That sounds like a threat.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一种威胁。

sentences.en: That does seem like a nicely worded threat.
sentences.zh: 那确实看起来像是一种措辞委婉的威胁。

sentences.en: And they got very angry at certain points when we tried to get out of the car.
sentences.zh: 当我们试图下车时，他们在某些时候变得非常愤怒。

sentences.en: I tried to have strategically upset stomachs.
sentences.zh: 我试着策略性地让自己“胃部不适”。

sentences.en: So we would stop and I would get out and slowly make my way to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能停车，我就可以下车，慢慢地走向洗手间。

sentences.en: And that would give Adam some time to be able to photograph.
sentences.zh: 这会给亚当一些时间去拍照。

sentences.en: And it would give Sao Nang, my colleague, time to kind of chat with people.
sentences.zh: 也会给我同事Sao Nang一些时间去和人们聊天。

sentences.en: And so there are ways in which we try to stop the car, to get out, stretch our legs, and maybe try to do as much news gathering in that short period of time as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我们尝试用各种方式停车，下车伸展一下腿脚，并尽可能在那短暂的时间里收集更多新闻。

sentences.en: So tell us about one of these stops that you make on the tour.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲你在参观途中停留的其中一个地方吧。

sentences.en: So two of the most remarkable places where we stopped were repatriation centers that had been built to welcome the Rohingya who were in Bangladesh, in the refugee camps,
sentences.zh: 我们停留的两个最引人注目的地方是遣返中心，那是为了欢迎在孟加拉国难民营里的罗兴亚人，

sentences.en: back to Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 回到缅甸而建造的。

sentences.en: The whole time it was just pouring rain and the sky and the sea and the mud, everything is brown.
sentences.zh: 整个过程中一直在下着倾盆大雨，天空、大海和泥土，一切都是棕色的。

sentences.en: And so we've got our rain jackets on, we've got our umbrellas, and we're kind of slosh, slosh, sloshing through.
sentences.zh: 我们穿着雨衣，打着伞，在泥泞中深一脚浅一脚地走着。

sentences.en: And we arrive at a place with barbed wire around it.
sentences.zh: 我们到达了一个周围有铁丝网的地方。

sentences.en: There are armed guards stationed very close to each other, holding their ancient Burmese rifles.
sentences.zh: 武装警卫站得很近，手里拿着他们古老的缅甸步枪。

sentences.en: And we wade through the water.
sentences.zh: 我们涉水穿过积水。

sentences.en: I mean, if Hollywood wanted to come up with a concentration camp setting, this would be a pretty good one.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果好莱坞想找一个集中营的场景，这会是一个非常好的选择。

sentences.en: And we walk in, it's white prefabricated buildings.
sentences.zh: 我们走进去，里面是白色的预制建筑。

sentences.en: This is the repatriation center.
sentences.zh: 这就是遣返中心。

sentences.en: This is where we're going to welcome back the Rohingya who had fled to Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们要欢迎那些逃往孟加拉国的罗兴亚人回来的地方。

sentences.en: Clearly, the government wants to show off what they have constructed, even though they don't believe that the Muslims belong in their country.
sentences.zh: 显然，政府想炫耀他们建造的东西，尽管他们并不认为穆斯林属于他们的国家。

sentences.en: They're being magnanimous and they're allowing them to come back in.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得很大度，允许他们回来。

sentences.en: Those repatriates do be transferred to another.
sentences.zh: 那些被遣返者会被转移到另一个地方。

sentences.en: And it's curious because there don't seem to be very many people around except for soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这很奇怪，因为除了士兵之外，周围似乎没有多少人。

sentences.en: There are a couple of dogs, which is sort of strange in a place where you're welcoming Muslims back.
sentences.zh: 有几条狗，在一个欢迎穆斯林回来的地方，这有点奇怪。

sentences.en: And we walk into one room and slosh, slosh, slosh.
sentences.zh: 我们走进一个房间，又是深一脚浅一脚地走着。

sentences.en: And on the ground is a row of kind of terrified-looking Rohingya.
sentences.zh: 地上坐着一排看起来惊恐万分的罗兴亚人。

sentences.en: And they're kind of curled up and kneeling.
sentences.zh: 他们蜷缩着，跪在那里。

sentences.en: And over them are soldiers, not pointing guns at them exactly, but their guns are prominent.
sentences.zh: 在他们上方是士兵，虽然没有直接用枪指着他们，但他们的枪支非常显眼。

sentences.en: And we start talking to these people.
sentences.zh: 我们开始和这些人交谈。

sentences.en: And it turns out that these people had not been repatriated.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，这些人根本没有被遣返。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, they had been living in their villages in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们一直住在缅甸的村庄里。

sentences.en: And one day, they said, Myanmar authorities came and threw them in jail.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他们说缅甸当局来把他们扔进了监狱。

sentences.en: They were in jail for five and a half months.
sentences.zh: 他们在监狱里待了五个半月。

sentences.en: And then they were released and charged with illegal immigration, even though they had been arrested in their villages in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 然后他们被释放并被指控非法移民，尽管他们是在缅甸的村庄里被捕的。

sentences.en: So they had never even left.
sentences.zh: 所以他们甚至从来没有离开过。

sentences.en: They had never even left the country.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至从来没有离开过这个国家。

sentences.en: And we had been given the impression that these were people who had been repatriated.
sentences.zh: 而我们之前得到的印象是，这些人是被遣返的人。

sentences.en: So these are essentially props.
sentences.zh: 所以他们本质上是道具。

sentences.en: They're props.
sentences.zh: 他们是道具。

sentences.en: And they're sitting cowered on the ground, surrounded by people with big guns, who are the precise people who would be associated with the ethnic cleansing of their people.
sentences.zh: 他们蜷缩在地上，被拿着大枪的人包围着，而这些人正是与针对他们族群的种族清洗有关的人。

sentences.en: It was an extraordinary, surreal experience.
sentences.zh: 那是一次非同寻常、超现实的经历。

sentences.en: Are these essentially prisoners?
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是囚犯吗？

sentences.en: Well, they were prisoners, and now they cannot leave a concentration camp that is ringed by barbed wire and monitored by soldiers and armed immigration guards.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们曾经是囚犯，现在他们无法离开这个被铁丝网环绕、由士兵和武装移民警卫监控的集中营。

sentences.en: I'm struck, Hannah, that this is sort of the best the government can do.
sentences.zh: 汉娜，我感到震惊的是，这竟然是政府能做到的最好程度。

sentences.en: It's remarkable because I'm not a Myanmar government official.
sentences.zh: 这很引人注目，因为我不是缅甸政府官员。

sentences.en: But if I were to try to bring foreign journalists to a place, I don't know, I would prep them better.
sentences.zh: 但如果我要尝试带外国记者去一个地方，我不知道，我会把他们准备得更好一些。

sentences.en: You know, I would find somebody who would be able to give a more compelling story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会找一个能讲出更令人信服的故事的人。

sentences.en: And I think it shows not only the incompetence of the government,
sentences.zh: 我认为这不仅显示了政府的无能，

sentences.en: but I think they just didn't know how to prepare carefully enough because they can't really get their heads around what it is that the world thinks about Myanmar now.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们只是不知道如何足够谨慎地准备，因为他们真的无法理解世界现在是如何看待缅甸的。

sentences.en: So I guess I'm curious why this ethnic cleansing campaign by the government would allow for any of the Rohingya, like the ones you're meeting in this welcome center,
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，为什么政府发起的这场种族清洗运动，还会允许像你在欢迎中心见到的那些罗兴亚人，

sentences.en: to be there alive still.
sentences.zh: 依然活着留在那里。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there was a clear push to get a lot of people out, but there are still a significant number of Rohingya who live in the country.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，确实有明确的推动力要把很多人赶出去，但仍有相当数量的罗兴亚人生活在这个国家。

sentences.en: Who stayed behind.
sentences.zh: 那些留下来的人。

sentences.en: Who stayed behind, and there are people who tried to leave and couldn't leave.
sentences.zh: 那些留下来的人，还有一些试图离开却没能离开的人。

sentences.en: And one of the most remarkable experiences I had, we were trying to cross a river, and we weren't sure whether the car would be able to cross the river,
sentences.zh: 我经历过最引人注目的事情之一是，我们试图过河，但不确定车能不能过河，

sentences.en: and so we got out of the car.
sentences.zh: 所以我们下了车。

sentences.en: And suddenly we see these people wading through the water, and we look at them, we're like, oh my gosh, they're Rohingya.
sentences.zh: 突然我们看到这些人涉水走过来，我们看着他们，心想，天哪，他们是罗兴亚人。

sentences.en: You know, so we kind of rush up to them and start talking with them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以我们冲向他们，开始和他们交谈。

sentences.en: And one of them was a woman who was in her probably 70s.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人是一位大概70多岁的妇女。

sentences.en: And because it was raining so heavily, I kind of pushed her under this police hut.
sentences.zh: 因为雨下得太大，我把她推到了一个警察岗亭下面。

sentences.en: And as soon as we got under the police hut, she was just shaking.
sentences.zh: 当我们一进入警察岗亭，她就在发抖。

sentences.en: I mean, I've never seen someone, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我从来没见过有人这样，你知道。

sentences.en: And I spoke a few words in the Rohingya language to her, and she was sort of holding my hand, and she said, you know, I don't want to be here.
sentences.zh: 我用罗兴亚语对她说了几句话，她握着我的手，她说，你知道，我不想待在这里。

sentences.en: I don't want to be here, but I can't leave.
sentences.zh: 我不想待在这里，但我走不了。

sentences.en: And there were some armed guards quite near us, and there was one particularly behind me.
sentences.zh: 附近有一些武装警卫，其中一个特别就在我身后。

sentences.en: And I could see, you know, she was kind of leaning in, but every now and then her eyes would dart behind me.
sentences.zh: 我能看到，你知道，她身体前倾，但时不时地，她的眼睛会瞥向我身后。

sentences.en: And I kind of looked, and I realized that there was an armed guard there, and she said, I do not want to be near those people.
sentences.zh: 我回头看了一眼，意识到那里有一个武装警卫，她说，我不想靠近那些人。

sentences.en: I don't like those people.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢那些人。

sentences.en: She was really almost too scared to speak.
sentences.zh: 她真的几乎害怕得说不出话来。

sentences.en: But it was one of my rare moments where I was having kind of a free interaction with a Rohingya in Rakhine State, which is, of course, their homeland.
sentences.zh: 但那是我在若开邦——当然，那是他们的家园——与罗兴亚人进行自由交流的罕见时刻之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what did she manage to tell you in this truncated conversation?
sentences.zh: 在这段简短的对话中，她设法告诉了你什么？

sentences.en: She managed to tell me that her village had been burnt down.
sentences.zh: 她设法告诉我，她的村庄被烧毁了。

sentences.en: She managed to tell me that she had tried to escape to Bangladesh and had not been able to do so.
sentences.zh: 她设法告诉我，她曾试图逃往孟加拉国，但没能成功。

sentences.en: And it seems like now she has been kind of constricted to a certain radius around where she's living, but she can't go very much further.
sentences.zh: 看起来现在她被限制在她居住地周围的一定半径内，不能走得太远。

sentences.en: And every time I saw her walk by or even kind of see somebody who represented Myanmar officialdom, her whole body language changed.
sentences.zh: 每次我看到她走过，或者甚至看到任何代表缅甸官方的人，她的整个肢体语言都会改变。

sentences.en: You know, she kind of crouched.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她会蜷缩起来。

sentences.en: She didn't want to make eye contact.
sentences.zh: 她不想有眼神交流。

sentences.en: She just seemed like an absolutely traumatized, terrified person.
sentences.zh: 她看起来完全是一个受过创伤、惊恐万分的人。

sentences.en: Well, what are you thinking as you're talking with a Rohingya woman like this?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你和这样的罗兴亚妇女交谈时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I mean, are you worried that she, and as well the people who are in that welcome center, will be punished for talking to you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你是否担心她，以及欢迎中心里的那些人，会因为和你交谈而受到惩罚？

sentences.en: It seems like they could really face some serious consequences for telling the truth, which is at odds with the government's story.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们确实可能因为说出真相而面临严重的后果，而这与政府的说法相矛盾。

sentences.en: In her case, she really wanted to get her message out.
sentences.zh: 就她而言，她确实想把自己的信息传达出去。

sentences.en: And it was one of those situations where I think she understood the implications of what she was saying.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况是，我认为她明白自己所说的话意味着什么。

sentences.en: She was saying, I am trapped.
sentences.zh: 她说，我被困住了。

sentences.en: I want to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我想离开这里。

sentences.en: Please send the message that we are a terrified people and we don't have many choices.
sentences.zh: 请传达这样一个信息：我们是一个处于恐惧中的民族，我们没有太多选择。

sentences.en: And the fact that we've suddenly run into a foreign journalist as we're crossing a swollen river in Myanmar has given her this kind of unprecedented opportunity to get a message out to the world.
sentences.zh: 而当我们穿过缅甸一条涨水的河流时，突然遇到了一位外国记者，这给了她一个前所未有的机会，把信息传达给世界。

sentences.en: Most of the time that we were on this trip, we were in a car.
sentences.zh: 在这次行程的大部分时间里，我们都是坐在车里。

sentences.en: And it was very frustrating in many times because it was raining.
sentences.zh: 很多时候让人感到非常沮丧，因为一直在下雨。

sentences.en: We couldn't see very clearly out of the car.
sentences.zh: 我们无法透过车窗看清外面。

sentences.en: I was having to unroll my window and re-roll it up to make sure the condensation wasn't too bad.
sentences.zh: 我不得不反复摇下和摇上车窗，以确保冷凝水不会太严重。

sentences.en: And we would see tantalizing little glimpse of things.
sentences.zh: 我们只能看到一些令人心痒的小片段。

sentences.en: And we asked our driver, we said, so are any of the burned villages, forget about who burned the villages, was it the Rohingya or was it the Rakhine, where are the burned villages?
sentences.zh: 我们问司机，我说，那么有没有被烧毁的村庄——先别管是谁烧的，是罗兴亚人还是若开人——被烧毁的村庄在哪里？

sentences.en: And he said, oh, I don't think there are really any around here.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我觉得这附近真的没什么被烧毁的村庄。

sentences.en: And then we started, as we were driving, we would see signs for some of the places where we knew massacres had happened.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们开车行驶时，开始看到一些我们知道发生过屠杀的地方的标志。

sentences.en: And so one of the telltale signs of a village that had been burnt was that the palm trees themselves were still there, but they were blackened poles.
sentences.zh: 村庄被烧毁的一个明显迹象是，棕榈树本身还在，但变成了焦黑的杆子。

sentences.en: And at the very top of the palm tree, we usually have the fronds.
sentences.zh: 在棕榈树的最顶端，通常会有叶子。

sentences.en: There was nothing there.
sentences.zh: 但那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: So you had these kind of forlorn-looking sticks, poles sticking out.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的就像是凄凉的棍子，光秃秃的杆子戳在那里。

sentences.en: And so once we saw those, we knew that we were in an area where there had been a Rohingya village.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们看到这些，我们就知道我们身处曾经有过罗兴亚村庄的地区。

sentences.en: And then your eyes become attuned and you start seeing little things.
sentences.zh: 然后你的眼睛会变得敏锐，开始注意到一些细微的东西。

sentences.en: Like at one point, we saw the dome of a mosque kind of toppled on the side with the star on it.
sentences.zh: 比如有一次，我们看到一个清真寺的圆顶侧翻在地上，上面还有一颗星。

sentences.en: And these little bits that showed that hundreds of thousands of people had lived in this region, but there was nothing left except for this distritus.
sentences.zh: 这些点滴表明，曾经有成千上万的人生活在这个地区，但除了这些残骸，什么都没剩下。

sentences.en: And eventually we were able to get to a small village where, again, we met with the locals and the government officials.
sentences.zh: 最终我们到达了一个小村庄，在那里我们再次会见了当地人和政府官员。

sentences.en: And they said the usual line, which is, yes, the Rohingya burned down their own villages and then they mysteriously left and they haven't come back.
sentences.zh: 他们说了那套老生常谈的话：是的，罗兴亚人烧毁了自己的村庄，然后神秘地离开了，再也没有回来。

sentences.en: We don't really understand why.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不明白为什么。

sentences.en: And I went actually to a few houses and just kind of slipped in.
sentences.zh: 我实际上溜进了几户人家。

sentences.en: And it was raining quite heavily,
sentences.zh: 当时雨下得很大，

sentences.en: so it was easier to sort of get away from the miners because maybe their umbrellas weren't as good as ours or they didn't want to be splashing through the water.
sentences.zh: 所以更容易避开那些陪同人员，因为也许他们的雨伞不如我们的好，或者他们不想在雨中跋涉。

sentences.en: And we got to a house and there was a family there.
sentences.zh: 我们来到一户人家，那里有一家人。

sentences.en: And there was a little girl.
sentences.zh: 还有一个小女孩。

sentences.en: She was maybe 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 她大概14岁。

sentences.en: She said, well, why are you here?
sentences.zh: 她说，你们为什么来这里？

sentences.en: And I said, well, because of the troubles last year.
sentences.zh: 我说，是因为去年的动乱。

sentences.en: And she said, yeah, you know, I'm a little bit sad about the troubles because I had a Muslim friend who lived a few doors down and I really miss her.
sentences.zh: 她说，是啊，你知道，我对那场动乱感到有点难过，因为我有一个住在几户人家之外的穆斯林朋友，我真的很想她。

sentences.en: And so we talked about her friend and, you know, it was clear that it was one of her besties.
sentences.zh: 我们聊起了她的朋友，很明显那是她最好的朋友之一。

sentences.en: And I said, so what happened to her?
sentences.zh: 我说，那她后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: And she sort of, she's quiet and she said, well, the Rakhine Buddhists, they burned down the Muslim houses.
sentences.zh: 她沉默了一下，然后说，若开族的佛教徒烧毁了穆斯林的房子。

sentences.en: This was the first time that I had heard somebody in Rakhine State tell what I believed was a true narrative.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次在若开邦听到有人讲述我认为是真实的情况。

sentences.en: And it's a child.
sentences.zh: 而且还是个孩子。

sentences.en: And it's a child.
sentences.zh: 这还是个孩子。

sentences.en: And she was innocent enough not to know what the narrative that she was supposed to give to a foreign journalist was.
sentences.zh: 她天真得不知道自己应该对外国记者说些什么“标准答案”。

sentences.en: But immediately there was a young man next to her and he kind of poked her and said, you know, that's not what you're supposed to say.
sentences.zh: 但旁边的一个年轻人立刻戳了她一下，说，你知道，你不该这么说。

sentences.en: You're supposed to say that the Muslims burned down their own villages.
sentences.zh: 你应该说穆斯林烧毁了他们自己的村庄。

sentences.en: And then the girl looked kind of shamefaced and she looked down at the ground.
sentences.zh: 女孩看起来一脸羞愧，低下了头。

sentences.en: And then we went outside and we were near a soccer pitch.
sentences.zh: 然后我们走到外面，靠近一个足球场。

sentences.en: And there were some kids playing soccer.
sentences.zh: 有一些孩子在踢足球。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I went over and was talking to a few kids and one of them came up.
sentences.zh: 我走过去和几个孩子聊天，其中一个走了过来。

sentences.en: And he's, you know, he's one of those kids.
sentences.zh: 他就是那种孩子。

sentences.en: He was kind of a preteen but just had a confidence about it.
sentences.zh: 他大概处于青春期前，但表现得很有自信。

sentences.en: And I said, so hi, you know, what's your name?
sentences.zh: 我说，嗨，你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: We talked about Manchester United.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了曼联队。

sentences.en: We talked about football for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了一会儿足球。

sentences.en: And I said, so over there, that used to be the area where the Muslims lived.
sentences.zh: 我说，那边曾经是穆斯林居住的地方。

sentences.en: He said, yeah, you know, the Rakhine burned down their houses.
sentences.zh: 他说，是啊，你知道，是若开人烧毁了他们的房子。

sentences.en: And I thought, oh, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦，这很有意思。

sentences.en: So, you know, now we've got second child corroboration.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我们有了第二个孩子的佐证。

sentences.en: And I said, but I thought that the Muslims burned down their own villages.
sentences.zh: 我说，但我以为是穆斯林烧毁了他们自己的村庄。

sentences.en: And he looked at me and he said, but that's stupid.
sentences.zh: 他看着我说，那太蠢了。

sentences.en: Why would the Muslims burn down their own villages?
sentences.zh: 穆斯林为什么要烧毁自己的村庄？

sentences.en: Which is a very good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And it was posed by, you know, a young child.
sentences.zh: 而且是由一个年幼的孩子提出来的。

sentences.en: What is life like now in these places where the Rohingya used to be the majority and now these other people are just kind of living their lives there?
sentences.zh: 在那些曾经以罗兴亚人为主，而现在其他人生活在那里的地方，现在的生活是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, there's a sense of emptiness because this area was predominantly Muslim and now it's not.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一种空虚感，因为这个地区曾经以穆斯林为主，而现在不是了。

sentences.en: But in the remaining villages, two things have happened.
sentences.zh: 但在剩下的村庄里，发生了两件事。

sentences.en: One, the Rakhine and their other ethnic minorities, mostly Buddhists, a lot of them have been given new homes.
sentences.zh: 第一，若开人和其他少数民族，主要是佛教徒，他们中的许多人得到了新家。

sentences.en: There are these new little prefabricated shacks that have been gifted to the Buddhist populations.
sentences.zh: 有一些赠送给佛教徒人口的新建预制小屋。

sentences.en: But the other thing that's happened is that there has been a very concerted effort to build over some of the areas where the Muslims lived.
sentences.zh: 但另一件事是，人们非常刻意地在穆斯林曾经居住过的一些地方进行建设。

sentences.en: So, for instance, in the village with these two kids, we visited a nice new school.
sentences.zh: 例如，在那两个孩子所在的村庄，我们参观了一所漂亮的新学校。

sentences.en: And we asked around, so what used to be where this nice new primary school was?
sentences.zh: 我们四处打听，这所漂亮的新小学原址是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, that might have been where the Muslims lived.
sentences.zh: 哦，那可能曾经是穆斯林居住的地方。

sentences.en: They're literally paving over.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是在掩盖真相。

sentences.en: They're paving over.
sentences.zh: 他们正在进行覆盖。

sentences.en: And as you're driving, you see bulldozers.
sentences.zh: 当你开车时，你会看到推土机。

sentences.en: A lot of the companies that were crony companies to the military have been supporting an effort to essentially erase any kind of proof that the Muslims lived there.
sentences.zh: 许多与军方关系密切的公司一直在支持一项努力，基本上是抹去任何穆斯林曾经在那里居住过的证据。

sentences.en: There was one village called Indin, and that was famous for a massacre.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫因丁的村庄，以一场屠杀而闻名。

sentences.en: And I remember driving and reading the stories of where these Rohingya men had been executed.
sentences.zh: 我记得开车时读过关于这些罗兴亚男子被处决地点的报道。

sentences.en: And the description was of a road and then sort of a grassy area and then the ocean.
sentences.zh: 描述是一条路，然后是一片草地，接着是海洋。

sentences.en: And suddenly we found ourselves on a road next to a grassy area and then the ocean.
sentences.zh: 突然我们发现自己就在一条路旁边，旁边是一片草地，然后是海洋。

sentences.en: And we saw the sign for Indin and just looking there and saying, somewhere here, this is where the massacre happened.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了因丁的标志，看着那里说，就在这附近的某个地方，屠杀发生了。

sentences.en: And there's no sign of where it was.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何标志显示它发生在哪里。

sentences.en: And it was so spooky and so surreal to be kind of racing by there as our drivers saying, no, no, no, there's nothing here.
sentences.zh: 当我们的司机说“不，不，不，这里什么都没有”时，那种感觉非常诡异且超现实。

sentences.en: There's nothing to see.
sentences.zh: 没什么可看的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, you feel like you're in a massive graveyard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你感觉自己身处一个巨大的墓地。

sentences.en: We know, Hannah, the story that the government wanted to create in this tour.
sentences.zh: 汉娜，我们知道政府在这次行程中想要营造的故事。

sentences.en: What is the story in the end that this tour actually told you?
sentences.zh: 最终，这次行程实际上告诉了你一个什么样的故事？

sentences.en: One of the things that struck me most about covering this issue is that the way in which the West in particular and broadly the international community sees the Rohingya issue and those people in Myanmar see the Rohingya issue,
sentences.zh: 在报道这个问题时，最让我震惊的一点是，西方尤其是国际社会看待罗兴亚问题的方式，与缅甸当地人看待罗兴亚问题的方式，

sentences.en: they are completely diametrically opposed.
sentences.zh: 它们是完全截然对立的。

sentences.en: And I've been covering Myanmar for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我报道缅甸已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: And in many ways, Myanmar was a good news story, right?
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，缅甸曾经是一个好消息，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it was a country in which a secretive military hunter voluntarily,
sentences.zh: 因为它是一个神秘的军政府自愿地、

sentences.en: bloodlessly gave up some power and allowed a Nobel Peace Prize laureate named Aung San Suu Kyi to be able to run part of a civilian administration.
sentences.zh: 不流血地放弃了一些权力，并允许一位名叫昂山素季的诺贝尔和平奖得主能够管理部分文职政府的国家。

sentences.en: And given all of the other trajectories in the world, which are pretty negative, you know, the rise of the strong man, the failure of the Arab Spring,
sentences.zh: 考虑到世界上其他的发展轨迹，那些相当负面的情况，比如强人的崛起、阿拉伯之春的失败，

sentences.en: this was such a powerful foreign policy story in which democracy seemed to be moving in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有力的外交政策故事，民主似乎正在朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: And so I think particularly those who were fighting the good fight for democracy felt almost betrayed when the narrative from the West turned from that to saying,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，特别是那些为民主而奋斗的人，当西方的叙事从那个故事转变为说“伙计们，我们有麻烦了，因为你们在若开邦北部所做的是种族清洗”时，他们感到几乎被背叛了。

sentences.en: we've got a problem, guys, because what you're doing in northern Rakhine is ethnic cleansing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为缅甸政府允许我们参加这次旅行的原因之一，是因为他们真的希望我们回到那个故事中去。

sentences.en: And so I think that one of the reasons that the Myanmar government allowed us to go on this trip was because they really wanted us to go back to that story.
sentences.zh: 那个好消息的故事。

sentences.en: The good news story.
sentences.zh: 你是去讲述那个好消息的。

sentences.en: You were there to tell the good news story.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 并说，看，伙计们，我们还有很多其他问题。

sentences.en: And to say, look, guys, you know, we've got a lot of other issues.
sentences.zh: 关于种族清洗这件事，那根本不是种族清洗。

sentences.en: And really, this ethnic cleansing thing, it's not ethnic cleansing.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，是罗兴亚人烧毁了他们自己的房子。

sentences.en: And by the way, the Rohingya burned their houses down.
sentences.zh: 让我们纠正你们错误的印象。

sentences.en: And let's correct your mistaken impression.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，到行程结束时，这显然不是我的想法。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, by the end of the tour, that's clearly not what I thought.
sentences.zh: 汉娜，非常感谢你讲述这个故事并进行这次报道。

sentences.en: Hannah, thank you very much for telling this story and for doing this reporting.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 我们将直播部分采访，供大家在11月18日于NYTimes.com免费观看。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
